failure: Pulseboard SDK 3.0.0 scroll engagement is wrong for MDviewer (Codex P2 on PR #105): measureScroll() reads window scroll over documentElement/body scrollHeight, but MDviewer scrolls documents inside #canvas while the body stays viewport-sized, so page.engaged.scroll reports ~100% regardless of reading depth. Analytics accuracy only: no privacy leak, no product impact.
workaround: Treat the scroll field of page.engaged as unreliable for mdviewer until the SDK is re-cut.
future_fix: Upstream fix in Pulseboard observatory (measure the #canvas scroller or accept a scroll-source hook), then re-cut the SDK and update public/pulseboard.js + observatory.lock.json via the normal SDK-update path. Superseded by the CLOSED row below (SDK 3.2.0, PR #107).
